entries.title: Stuck: remove it from the banners on every device
entries.text: Shows “Stuck: remove it from the banners on every device”. Part of Activity banner.

entries.title: Just finished ()

entries.title: GitHub repos to watch
entries.text: Where you set “GitHub repos to watch”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Activity banner.

entries.text: A banner from Activity banner: a strip at the top that keeps you posted. Right-click or long-press it for its settings.
